source_issue.title: isDisabled is ignored in Url widget

summary_markdown:
```markdown
## What this issue is about
This issue addresses a bug in the `UrlWidget` component of Volto where the `isDisabled` property does not function as expected. Even when `isDisabled` is set to true, the action buttons for selecting internal elements remain enabled.

## What needs to be done
The goal is to ensure that all interactive elements, including the button for opening the object browser and the clear button, are disabled when `isDisabled` is true. Currently, only the input field respects this property.

## Helpful background
- The issue was reported by [mcasagrande18](https://github.com/mcasagrande18) and confirmed by others. 
- The source code can be found [here](https://github.com/plone/volto/blob/master/src/components/manage/Widgets/UrlWidget.jsx). 
- As per recent discussions, this bug still exists in the latest version (Volto 19).

## Good first steps
1. Review the code in `UrlWidget.jsx`, focusing on how `isDisabled` is currently implemented.
2. Implement the logic to disable both action buttons when `isDisabled` is set to true.
3. Create tests to ensure that all elements respect the `isDisabled` property.
4. Consider updating any documentation if needed.
5. Open a pull request for review once your changes are made!
```
